turns.text: Make one image, aspect 1:1, from this exact description: Create a photorealistic colour photograph of a woman approximately sixty years old, framed vertically from upper chest to just above her hair. Her head turns slightly toward the viewer’s left, nearly upright, with dark eyes looking directly toward the camera. She has a long, broad oval face, high expansive forehead, subtly hollow cheeks, firm narrowing jaw, and rounded, moderately prominent chin. Fair skin shows fine forehead creases, a pronounced vertical furrow between the brows, crow’s-feet, under-eye folds, visible pores, and faint uneven pigmentation. Low, gently arched, sparse grey-brown eyebrows sit above deep-set, slightly hooded eyes. Her nose has a straight, substantial bridge and softly rounded tip; her small mouth is closed, with thin, pale lips and slightly downturned corners. Her expression is solemn, composed, and unsmiling. Grey hair with darker strands is loosely swept backward from an indistinct off-centre part, gathered behind her head, with airy waves and numerous fine flyaways around the temples and crown; no facial hair. Dress her in an early-twentieth-century dark wool jacket over a high, folded collar with contrasting geometric checks. Broad, soft light from upper left illuminates her forehead and left cheek, leaving gentle right-side shadows. Use a plain charcoal studio background, restrained natural colour, fine photographic grain, sharply resolved facial texture, and slightly softer clothing.
